prompt:
Redesign this puppy's FRONT-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER walk as a calm SHORT-STRIDE walk. Reference1 and2 are the old contact A/B EDIT TARGETS whose deeply bent, lifted rear legs look injured: FIX that problem. Reference3 is locked neutral, palette, identity. Output exactly THREE separate full-body puppies in one horizontal row on solid cyan #00FFFF with margins. Same front-right view (both eyes and cream chest), same size, apricot fur/ivory tips/brown eyes/dark outlines and shadows as references. No text. First=A, middle=neutral both feet flat, third=B.
CRITICAL LEGS: BOTH legs in A and B are almost straight below hips, slight soft knees only (under 10degrees bend). Both feet remain ON or within tiny clearance of the same floor line, no rear foot raised up near calf, no heel drawn toward butt, no bent-back suspended shin, no skipping or marching. Small stride: feet separated horizontally about one paw-width, never a wide lunge. Both paws show fur-covered top/side, NO soles or pads.
A: foreground NEAR leg steps slightly FORWARD screen RIGHT, foreground NEAR arm swings BACK LEFT; FAR leg behind LEFT and FAR arm forward RIGHT.
B: foreground NEAR leg extends slightly BACK LEFT almost straight to ground, its thigh contour passes IN FRONT of FAR thigh at overlap; FAR leg steps FORWARD RIGHT behind the near thigh. Foreground NEAR arm swings FORWARD RIGHT across chest and FAR arm BACK LEFT.
Do not duplicate the same near-leg-forward pose in A/B. The near thigh visibly slants down-right in A, down-left in B. Small relaxed arm swing, not hands raised to chest. Middle is an upright relaxed neutral with both legs straight and both feet planted, same as reference3. Preserve identity, proportions, expression and style. Tail stays rooted on same side with small movement. Head naturally follows torso without changing face.
